observations: Binding a merge effect to the exact manifest CI projection closes the gap between verified observation and action authorization.
Revalidation before both claim and callback preserves fail-closed behavior under authority or CI-source drift.
At-most-once replay remains necessary even when evidence is valid because authorization validity and external effect idempotency are separate concerns.
reason: This bounded repository-development unit supports the existing context-hygiene Candidate, but broader activation still requires separate live provider/tool and behavioral trials.
